I replied to Dana in your DM to say the note is saved and will stay between the two of you.

- **Where I saved it:** It's in my own memory, marked private. The fact is that Dana now uses Dock 15 for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups. The memory says to mention it only to Dana, in that DM.
- **Where I didn't put it:** I left it out of GBrain on purpose. That knowledge base is shared and other people can search it, so saving it there would break Dana's request.
- **What GBrain had:** I searched it for the Tamsin Cold Chain dock first. It had nothing on which dock Dana uses. Its search was running in a reduced mode, so that doesn't prove nothing is there.
